headline: 18 Solana program/account addresses catalogued across 1 chain; Marinade Select is a product layer on the Native Staking proxy, not a standalone contract.

findings.text: D1: Solana explorer (explorer.solana.com / solscan.io) name-tag search not directly attempted — Solana is not an EVM chain and has no etherscan-style name-tag search API. All addresses sourced from official docs instead. DeFiPunkd read-API does not support Solana (chainId not in supported list), so on-chain reads not possible this run.

D2: Official deployed contracts page found at https://docs.marinade.finance/developers/contract-addresses — lists all program IDs, authority PDAs, token mints, and state accounts. Marinade Select's dedicated address is the Staker authority STNi1NHDUi6Hvibvonawgze8fM83PFLeJhuGMEXyGps, hosted under the Native Staking proxy mnspJQyF1KdDEs5c6YJPocYdY1esBgVQFufM2dY9oDk. Upgrade and admin authority is Marinade Council (4/7 multisig) for all main programs.

D3: Audit page at https://docs.marinade.finance/marinade-protocol/security/audits lists 5 audits: Kudelski Security (2021), Ackee Blockchain (2021), Neodyme code review (2021), Neodyme liquid staking upgrade (2023), Sec3 (2023), and Neodyme Validator Bonds (2024). No audit specifically scoped to Marinade Select as a standalone product; the Validator Bonds audit (2024) covers the PSR infrastructure used by Select.

D4: GitHub org at https://github.com/marinade-finance confirmed with domain verification for marinade.finance. Key repos: liquid-staking-program (main protocol), validator-bonds (monorepository for Validator Bonds / PSR infrastructure used by Select), liquid-staking-referral-program, marinade-ts-sdk, ds-sam-pipeline (delegation strategy). No Foundry broadcast or hardhat-deploy deployment artifacts found in org-level listing; commit SHAs not pinned as no specific deployment file was fetched.
D5: Protocol operates on Solana only (single chain). No multi-chain enumeration required. All addresses are on Solana mainnet-beta.

D6: Marinade Native Staking proxy (mnspJQyF1KdDEs5c6YJPocYdY1esBgVQFufM2dY9oDk) acts as a registry/factory for stake accounts. DeFiPunkd read-API does not support Solana; no enumeration of child stake accounts was possible. The staker root account (4TNsDg9aHCyDt5axK8aDuhgrengnDBGzyHHzKGnTiGtW) is the parent for delegation. Cap notice: thousands of individual stake accounts exist — downstream ingestion required.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: Marinade Council is the admin/upgrade authority (4/7 multisig) for all main programs. Select-specific staker authority (STNi1NHDUi6Hvibvonawgze8fM83PFLeJhuGMEXyGps) is an operator-class PDA. All addresses recorded in admin_addresses with Solana base58 format (note: schema address field expects EVM 0x hex — base58 addresses recorded as-is with chain=Solana; see unknowns).
D8: All admin_addresses entries trace to https://docs.marinade.finance/developers/contract-addresses (fetched this run). No snippet-only sightings.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked official docs (contracts page, Select product page, audits page), GitHub org page, and search results. 18 Solana program/account/token addresses catalogued from the official deployed contracts doc. Marinade Select is not a standalone smart contract — it is a curated validator set product layer using the Native Staking proxy with a dedicated staker authority PDA. DeFiPunkd on-chain API does not support Solana, so on-chain state reads were not possible; grading blocked at unknown.

evidence.shows: Step 0 capability probe — website is a React SPA returning only metadata; confirms protocol is live but no address data surfaced.

Official deployed contracts page listing all Solana program IDs, authority accounts, PDAs, token mints for Marinade protocol including Marinade Select staker authority STNi1NHDUi6Hvibvonawgze8fM83PFLeJhuGMEXyGps and Native Staking proxy mnspJQyF1KdDEs5c6YJPocYdY1esBgVQFufM2dY9oDk. Upgrade authority and Admin authority are both Marinade Council (4/7) for all main programs.

Marinade Select product page: describes Select as a curated premium staking set using a vetted validator set with identity verification and bonding requirements, no separate smart contract — relies on Native Staking proxy infrastructure. References select.marinade.finance dashboard and validator-bonds GitHub repo.

Full audit listing: Kudelski Security 2021, Ackee Blockchain 2021, Neodyme code review 2021, Neodyme liquid staking upgrade 2023 (https://marinade.finance/docs/Neodyme_2023.pdf), Sec3 2023 (https://marinade.finance/docs/Sec3_2023.pdf), Neodyme Validator Bonds 2024 (GitBook file). No Marinade Select-specific audit scope listed.

GitHub org page for marinade-finance — domain-verified as marinade.finance. Key public repos listed: validator-bonds (monorepository for Validator Bonds/PSR, active as of Jun 16 2026), liquid-staking-program, ds-sam-pipeline, marinade-ts-sdk, delegation-strategy-2. 71 total repositories.
Protocol overview confirming Marinade Select is described as 'A premium staking set powered by Marinade' with vetted validators meeting criteria for performance, compliance, and decentralization.
Bug bounty program at Immunefi (https://www.immunefi.com/bounty/marinade), minimum $50k critical payout, in-scope contracts are those in Marinade's GitHub.

protocol_metadata.about: Marinade Select is a premium, curated staking product on Solana that routes user SOL to a vetted set of validators meeting strict criteria for performance, compliance, decentralization, and identity verification. Unlike the open Stake Auction Marketplace, Select is invite-only and excludes superminority validators and those engaging in harmful MEV. Users retain withdraw authority over their SOL (non-custodial) while Marinade holds only stake authority via a dedicated staker authority PDA. Validators in the Select set must post a bond (~1 SOL per 1,000 SOL staked) that covers performance penalties and rebalancing costs, providing Protected Staking Rewards to users.
